name: reporting_evidence_coverage
description: Aggregate feedback and evidence-request coverage for an assessment cycle across the caller's org subtree (admins see the whole cycle): feedback provided by request or as proactive feedback, immutable manager/report/peer directionality, withdrawn feedback, where it was given (by_origin: the stable key 'growthos' for feedback given here — labelled with the tenant's product name — or the system it arrived from), request statuses, fulfilment rate, participant coverage, and optional manager/role/level groups. Pass month (YYYY-MM) to narrow to feedback recorded and requests sent in one calendar month of the cycle; the response lists the months available.

cycle_id.description: An assessment cycle's id, from reporting_cycles_list.

month.description: Calendar month within the cycle, YYYY-MM. Omit for the whole cycle.
